title: kstevica/captain-claw
summary: Command a fleet of AI agents, on every deck, every desk, every wrist. Self-hosted multi-agent platform with memory, a coding pipeline, Flows, a team kiosk and voice devices. Any LLM, or 100% local with Ollama.

title: moooossee/moose
summary: Chat with local and cloud AI

title: yubozhao/isoform

summary: Agent Orchestrator App
